operator_scope: offline only. No camera. Ground truth from the host encoder on real and synthetic frames.
asked_for: a simple, fast predictor to prevent a frame from being sent down a path it cannot survive
verdict: IT WORKS ON ORDINARY CONTENT AND IS DEFEATABLE BY CONSTRUCTION. Fit to choose between two recoverable paths; NOT fit to authorise zero-copy, where being wrong destroys the frame.

the_asymmetry_that_governs_everything.copy_back: decides AFTER the encode, from the size table. A wrong guess costs nothing.
the_asymmetry_that_governs_everything.zero_copy: the codec writes over the source, so by the time the size is known the source is gone.
the_asymmetry_that_governs_everything.consequence: a predictor that can be wrong cannot guard an operation that cannot be undone. It can only choose between paths that are both correct.

the_host_encoder_is_now_a_ground_truth_g.claim: research/slimRAW/ljenc.py reproduces the camera's tile sizes
the_host_encoder_is_now_a_ground_truth_g.evidence: against the camera's own twelve sizes for A001_090 frame 1: nine identical, three within three bytes, and the twelfth 454 smaller - which is the 457 zero bytes the camera pads onto the last tile. Sum 1,396,285 against 1,396,736, a 0.03% difference that is entirely that padding.
the_host_encoder_is_now_a_ground_truth_g.consequence: any stock frame plus this encoder is a calibration point, and no camera session is needed to make more.

design.sampling: 12 tiles x 4 windows x 2 rows x 128 samples = 12,288 residuals, 0.54% of the frame
design.residual: d = raw[y][x] - raw[y][x-2], two columns left because adjacent columns are different CFA components
design.histogram: 13 bins, one per JPEG magnitude category, kept per column component
design.score: Huffman code lengths derived FROM the sampled histogram, then bits/sample = sum(p[k] * (len[k] + k)). No calibrated constant table, so there is nothing to fit.
design.estimate: padded_samples * bits / 8, plus 96 bytes per tile

first_calibration.note: eleven cases is not a calibration. Four of the real frames are the same scene and exposure, so this is about two independent conditions plus constructed extremes. No threshold follows from it.
first_calibration.on_ordinary_content: +0.06% to +5.42%, never under. The worst case that matters, uniform noise at 3.47 MB, is over-estimated to 3.57 MB and would correctly be routed away from zero-copy.

two_defects_found_by_adversarial_testing.defect: the sample-position rotation was a no-op
two_defects_found_by_adversarial_testing.detail: fy came from ((i + seq) % WINDOWS_PER_TILE), and as i runs 0..3 that covers the same four positions for EVERY seq. The sampler read identical rows on every frame. A frame with noise everywhere except those rows scored a perfect 1.000 bits per sample on all six seq values tried.
two_defects_found_by_adversarial_testing.fix: the offset is now a golden-ratio walk that moves the set; the same frame is caught at +2.2% to +4.6% on every other seq
two_defects_found_by_adversarial_testing.residual_exposure: seq 0 still fails on a frame built against seq 0. Rotation reduces the exposure from always-blind to blind-on-the-frames-a-pattern-happens-to-miss. It does not remove it.

two_defects_found_by_adversarial_testing.defect: I compared predicted PAYLOAD against actual FILE bytes
two_defects_found_by_adversarial_testing.detail: the payload estimate excludes each tile's own JPEG header, and the actual includes it, which manufactured a systematic under-estimate of about 12 x 81 bytes and made flat content look like a false positive

what_this_means_for_zero_copy: A predictor cannot authorise it. The failure mode is not a margin to be widened - it is total (-91.7%) and confident, and no sampling fraction below 100% removes it.

The thing that COULD authorise it is a hardware bound rather than a guess: F_INIT takes nine words of which [6] is the output pointer and [7] the size table, and the other seven are unknown. If one of them is an output cap, the engine stops on its own and no prediction is needed.
Until then zero-copy is a candidate for content already known to compress, not a general path, and copy-back remains the correct default because its decision is made after the fact.
where_the_predictor_IS_fit: the adaptive-mixed decision ROADMAP already contemplates: is this frame worth compressing at all. Being wrong there costs space or time, both recoverable.
telemetry and shadow-mode logging, per COMPRESSION_PRECHECK section 8 step 5
explicitly_not_established: any threshold. Eleven cases, two independent real conditions.
the cost of running it on the camera. This is host Python; the note's precheck_us was never measured and the sampling has not been written in ARM.

behaviour on the scenes COMPRESSION_PRECHECK section 8 step 3 requires: correctly-exposed high ISO, shadow noise, local texture, scene cuts, grouped by clip so adjacent frames do not fake generalisation

whether row-correlated sensor patterns - readout banding, rolling shutter artefacts - resemble the adversarial case closely enough to matter in practice. Not tested, and 'real content will not do that' is the assumption that fails once and destroys a frame.
